_about: Public-domain Alexander Viets Griswold (1766-1843), Bishop of the Eastern Diocese and presiding bishop of the Episcopal Church, an evangelical, for the Word Hoard: Discourses on the Most Important Doctrines and Duties of the Christian Religion (1830), Prayers Adapted to Various Occasions of Social Worship (1836), The Reformation (1843) and Remarks on Social Prayer-Meetings (1858), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 40 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

griswold-discourses-1830: Discourses on the most important doctrines and duties of the Christian religion (Philadelphia, W. Stavely, 1830)
griswold-prayers-1836: Prayers adapted to various occasions of social worship, for which provision is not made in the Book of common prayer (Philadelphia : W. Marshall & co.; Providence, Marshall, Brown & co., 1836)
griswold-reformation-1843: The reformation: a brief exposition of some of the errors and corruptions of the church of Rome (Boston, J. B. Dow, 1843)
griswold-prayer-meetings-1858: Remarks on social prayer-meetings (Boston, Gould and Lincoln; New York, Sheldon, Blakeman & co.; [etc., etc.], 1858)

_excluded.griswold-other: Works by Alexander V. G. Allen (Continuity of Christian Thought, Life of Phillips Brooks, and others), which the catalogue files under Griswold's name
